text:
maria-support: Heads up — raised by a customer (ticket #C-2026). In the support console the agent clicked 'Apply free trial' and got a green toast "Success: credits applied", but the customer's billing ledger shows no new credit entry and their trial balance stayed 0. cust_id=acct_9H2kL, promo_code=TRIALQ2. Screenshot attached in ticket.
kevin-backoffice: ugh. Can you paste the support-console action log (request id) and the timestamp? I want to see what the backoffice service returned.
maria-support: request_id=tx_20260311_5b7e9, console logs show HTTP 200 and body {"status":"ok","operation_id":"op_5b7e9"}. Ticket time 2026-03-11T14:02:23Z.
nora-support: saw a couple similar sounding ones earlier this morning — short threads where toast said success but no ledger row. Might be flaky replay/dedup logic.
josh-eng: can you grab the backoffice worker logs for op_5b7e9? My initial guess: support console acknowledges on enqueue but the worker failed when writing ledger and consumer didn't surface error to UI.
maria-support: pasted the worker stdout from around the time: ```INFO processing op_5b7e9
ERROR ledger_writer: write failed: duplicate_key: fk_account not found
WARN consumer: acking message after transient failure``` — looks weird: duplicate_key + fk not found?
sara-sre: that combination smells like a partial DB migration race. Duplicate_key usually from unique constraint; fk_account not found means the foreign key lookup failed — are we seeing retries with missing account row because of eventual consistency between services? What DB instance was the worker pointed at?
kevin-backoffice: worker was on backoffice-prod-4 (us-west). The ledger writer saves to billing_db.primary. No recent schema changes in mainline but we did run the quick patch for tombstone replay protection yesterday.
josh-eng: can you grep for the op id in the replay/deduper logs? Might be tombstone tombstoned but replayed incorrectly.
kevin-backoffice: checked: deduper returned "already_processed" for idempotency token X-Idempotency:abc-123 earlier, but op has a different op_id. There's a gap between support console's operation_id and backoffice internal dedupe key mapping.
maria-support: customer still blocked. Manual workaround possible?
kevin-backoffice: manual fix for now: run the backoffice admin endpoint POST /admin/ledger/reconcile with body {"cust_id":"acct_9H2kL","op_id":"op_5b7e9","amount":5000,"reason":"support_manual_trial_grant"} — that will force a ledger row and emit audit. I'll run it if eng signs off.
josh-eng: ok to run with these caveats but prefer we not hit DB directly. We should also preserve traces for postmortem. I'll shim a guarded reconcile call and capture full stacktraces. @sara-sre please watch DB for deadlocks.
sara-sre: watching. also set a short trace retention for these ops. If we see FK errors again, escalate to infra-db. Might be a replica lag/txn boundary causing account row to be missing at write-time.
credits-bot: action queued: reconcile_request queued id rq_9c3f
kevin-backoffice: I executed reconcile (rq_9c3f). API returned 201 and ledger row created. Customer updated. Please confirm with the customer and close ticket.
maria-support: confirmed with customer — credits appeared and they could start trial. emailed them; ticket updated.
josh-eng: root cause hypothesis: support-console returns success on enqueue (200) but does not surface worker errors. Also mismatch between idempotency/deduper keys allowed duplicate enqueue attempts that silently acked. Plan: 1) change console to wait for worker ack for critical actions (or at least show pending state), 2) unify idempotency token mapping between front-end op_id and backoffice deduper, 3) add observable metric when ledger write returns FK/unique constraint errors.
kevin-backoffice: will open a backoffice issue and schedule a patch. Also adding a small endpoint for support to safely reconcile and list pending ops.
josh-eng: I'll own the patch for idempotency mapping and event surfacing. Target hotfix deploy tomorrow (2026-03-12 morning). Will post PR and link here.
sara-sre: also adding an alert on "ack with no ledger row" metric so support can detect these quickly.
maria-support: thanks all. Moving ticket to pending-fix until hotfix lands. :thumbsup:
notes: Support console shows success toast when enqueue succeeds; backoffice worker may fail to persist; manual reconcile endpoint used as temporary fix; eng to patch idempotency mapping and UI surfacing; SRE to add alert.
